description: This file contains multiple FastAPI test cases, utilizing pytest and testing various API endpoints including data validation, request handling, and schema definitions for nested models. It also dynamically imports different app modules based on parameters.

methods.name: get_client(request: pytest.FixtureRequest)
methods.description: Pytest fixture that dynamically imports and creates a TestClient for different app modules based on parameter.

methods.name: test_put_all(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests updating an item with all fields provided, verifying the response structure and contents.

methods.name: test_put_only_required(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests updating an item with only required fields, ensuring optional fields default correctly.

methods.name: test_put_empty_body(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests sending an empty JSON payload, expecting validation errors for missing required fields.

methods.name: test_put_images_not_list(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests sending an incorrect type for the images field (not a list), expecting validation error.

methods.name: test_openapi_schema(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Validates the generated OpenAPI schema are correct and include nested models and validation details.
